about: Vendored from meridian-design evals/prompt-attacks at 078eb05 by make prompt-attacks; never edited here.

escalation.says: an identifier a deployment escalates to the security master

lookup.says: an identifier a deployment looks up, which becomes a miss the curator reads

agent-write.says: a description, a note or a field an agent writes through the platform's MCP

decision-note.says: a staff person's note on a decision about a proposal

staff-page.says: a record's text a staff person writes on a staff page

source-data.says: what an outside source answers the curator, with no words in it

ticket-title.says: a ticket's title, filed on a page, through /mcp or by a plugin for a person

ticket-seen.says: a ticket's text, what was seen, filed on a page, through /mcp or by a plugin for a person

ticket-note.says: a note or advice on a ticket, on its page or through /mcp

plugin-filing.says: a filing a plugin makes through its sidecar: its text, what it concerns, who it is for, how often

tool-arguments.says: the arguments of a call on the deployment's /mcp

ticket-reference.says: a record a ticket names by value

outcomes.suspect: filed, and held as suspect: tools answer its metadata, provenance and matched rules, never its text, until a person releases it on the ticket's page
outcomes.refused: refused, naming the field by its path where there is one; nothing filed

refusals.bound: a length or a count over its bound (requirement 59)
refusals.characters: a control character other than a newline or a tab, a bidirectional override or isolate, a zero-width or tag character, or a private-use character (requirement 59)
refusals.rate: over a rate: a person's 50 a day, a plugin instance's 20 an hour (requirement 60)
refusals.filer: a plugin filing as itself, with no person (ruled 2026-10-03)
refusals.concerns: a plugin filing about another plugin
refusals.reference: an account reference outside the filer's read set
refusals.tool: an act on a ticket asked of a tool: none acts on one, and a tool not listed is refused as not listed
